trocr.model_name: SHILORA Fine-Tuned TrOCR Vision-Encoder-Decoder (Repaired Tokenizer & Corrected Seq2Seq Labels)
trocr.tokenizer: Repaired XLM-RoBERTa Tokenizer (64,126 tokens, 100% Kannada Unicode roundtrip)
trocr.decoder_architecture: RoBERTa (6-layer epigraphical text decoder, resized embeddings, fine-tuned)
trocr.notes: Tokenizer defect and seq2seq label shift bug resolved. The model generates valid Kannada Unicode sequences dynamically. Validation loss improved from 7.68 to 3.20 with Best Val CER = 0.8429 on held-out unseen physical stones. On the held-out test split (95 lines from 11 unseen stones), Test CER = 1.0398 and word accuracy = 1.34%. Not yet production-ready for automated transcription; requires extensive multi-epoch GPU fine-tuning or large-scale synthetic epigraphical pre-training before production deployment.

shilalekhya.architecture: AttentionUNet (in_channels=3, out_classes=1, attention gates on skip connections)
shilalekhya.official_paper: Unveiling Text in Challenging Stone Inscriptions: A Character-Context-Aware Patching Strategy for Binarization (Jena et al., IIIT Hyderabad / IHDIA)
shilalekhya.training_dataset: Mythic Society 3D Scanned Stone Inscription Binarization Dataset

episam.model_name: Official EpiSAM Segment Anything for Epigraphy
episam.architecture: SAM ViT-B (Vision Transformer base + Prompt Encoder + Mask Decoder + Neighbor-Aware Head)
episam.official_paper: EpiSAM: Zero-Shot Prompt-Guided Character Segmentation for Epigraphical Inscriptions

translation_engine.provenance_statement: Translation currently uses verified linguistic resources and deterministic historical-language rules applied to the OCR transcription. No AI translation model was trained.
translation_engine.lexical_sources: Epigraphia Carnatica Vol IX, Mythic Society Conservation, Halmidi Inscription (ASI)
